prompt:
You are two people at once: a first-time viewer scrolling a vertical-video feed who has NEVER
seen this show and knows none of its characters, and the ad buyer who decides which clips get paid reach.
Each clip below is written out exactly as it would play (t = seconds since the clip began; a new
segment means a hard cut). Speaker names are production notes: a real viewer only learns a name if
someone says it out loud or it is obvious from the picture.

For every clip, answer honestly and use the full 1-10 range (most clips are not a 9):
- first_3s_hook: judged ONLY on what happens between t=0 and t=3. 1 = nothing would stop a scroll.
- cliffhanger_open: at the final cut, how badly does the viewer need to know what happens next?
  1 = everything is settled.
- cold_viewer_clarity: can a stranger tell who these people are to each other and what is at stake,
  from this clip alone? 1 = lost.
- ambiguity: every concrete confusion, each with kind = pronoun | relationship | unexplained_name |
  prior_event | speaker_identity, the beat_id where it happens, and a short detail. Empty list if none.
- ending_resolves_tension: true if the last beats answer or defuse the tension.
- Boundary fixes (optional; only beat_ids printed inside that clip):
  trim_start_to = the beat that should open the clip if the current first 3 seconds are weak
                  (must be in segment 1); trim_end_at = the beat the clip should cut on if the current
                  ending lets the air out (must be in the last segment). Use null when the boundary is right.
  Clips must stay 20-60 seconds; a trim that breaks that is discarded. Give trim_reason when you trim.
- hook_line and cliffhanger_line: copy the exact words from the clip text (no beat id, no speaker).
- viewer_takeaway: one sentence - what a stranger thinks this story is about.
- why_it_works: one line for the ad buyer.

t=010.2 E29.B059 LINE: JULIANA (Sobbing, Heartbroken): "Mother..."

t=013.3 E29.B061 LINE: JULIANA (Desperate, Shouting): "I have done nothing!"
t=015.6 E29.B062 SHOT: Tight profile close-up of Juliana gripping the rusted iron bars, screaming out into the empty stone corridor.
t=015.7 E29.B063 LINE: JULIANA (Screaming, Hysterical): "I saved her! I healed her!"
t=018.5 E29.B064 SHOT: Medium shot from inside the cell as Juliana pounds her fists rhythmically against the reinforced iron door.
t=018.5 E29.B065 SOUND: Muffled, dull metallic clanging reverberates as Juliana hammers against the iron door.
t=018.6 E29.B066 LINE: JULIANA (Shouting in Anguish): "I saved the Duchess!"
t=021.9 E29.B067 SHOT: Medium shot of Juliana slumping down against the rough stone wall, pulling her knees to her chest while weeping softly.
t=022.5 E29.B068 LINE: JULIANA (V.O., Sorrowful, Wounded): "They took my mother's ledger..."
t=025.0 E29.B069 SHOT: Front medium shot of Juliana slowly rising to her feet, crossing her arms firmly across her chest as her tears stop and her expression hardens into steely resolve.
t=025.0 E29.B070 LINE: JULIANA (V.O., Quiet Resolve, Unbreakable): "They took her locket. But they will not take Alexander from me."

== segment 1/1 - continuous - episode 30 ==
t=000.0 E30.B018 LINE: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Fierce, Venomous): "Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!"   <- inside first 3 seconds
t=006.2 E30.B019 SHOT: Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.
t=008.2 E30.B020 LINE: RUPERT (Faltering, Submissive): "What are you suggesting?"
t=010.2 E30.B021 SHOT: Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.
t=011.2 E30.B022 LINE: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Calculated, Ominous): "We stop hiding the prisoner."
t=014.0 E30.B023 SHOT: Tracking shot from behind the Elder Nobleman as he pushes open the heavy double doors into the dark wood-paneled library.
t=014.4 E30.B024 SOUND: The heavy creak of massive mahogany doors gliding open on brass hinges.
t=017.4 E30.B025 SHOT: Front medium shot of the Elder Nobleman pausing inside the library doorway, Rupert following behind him.
t=017.6 E30.B026 LINE: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Deadpan, Sinister): "We give them a reason to condemn her."
t=021.0 E30.B027 SHOT: Wide shot of Catherine standing regally before the roaring stone hearth, dressed in an ornate burgundy and gold brocade gown, slowly unfurling a red lace fan.
t=023.4 E30.B028 LINE: CATHERINE (Inquiring, Sharp): "You have a solution?"
t=025.2 E30.B029 SHOT: Side profile close-up of the Elder Nobleman speaking with icy confidence.
t=025.8 E30.B030 LINE: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Ruthless): "We use the law to destroy her."
t=028.9 == CLIP ENDS ==

t=003.2 E30.B044 LINE: RUPERT (Stunned): "Witchcraft is a capital charge."

t=006.2 E30.B046 LINE: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Unflinching): "Precisely."
t=008.7 E30.B047 SHOT: Medium three-shot framing Rupert, the Elder Nobleman between them, and Catherine listening closely.
t=008.8 E30.B048 LINE: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Authoritative, Command): "Do not hide the evidence, manufacture it. Drag her before the magistrate tomorrow, frame the trial, buy the jury, and let the State hang her."
t=016.1 E30.B049 SHOT: Close-up of Catherine smiling with malicious satisfaction, fluttering her fan.
t=016.4 E30.B050 LINE: CATHERINE (Scheming): "Her botanical ledger..."
t=018.6 E30.B051 SHOT: Close-up of the Elder Nobleman nodding slowly.

t=020.8 E30.B053 SHOT: Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward.
t=021.5 E30.B054 LINE: CATHERINE (Inquiring): "And the Dowager?"
t=023.2 E30.B055 SHOT: Medium shot of the Elder Nobleman gesturing dismissively with one gloved hand.
t=023.7 E30.B056 LINE: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Dismissive): "She is weak, confused. No magistrate will trust a dying woman's accusations against a respected household."
t=031.0 E30.B057 SHOT: Medium close-up of Rupert exhaling deeply, processing the horrifying certainty of their conspiracy.
t=034.2 E30.B058 LINE: RUPERT (Hesitant): "And Juliana?"
t=036.1 E30.B059 SHOT: Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring sternly across the desk.
t=036.6 E30.B060 LINE: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Resolute): "She goes before the magistrate tomorrow."
